caption: The drawing features a light gray or beige background with a simple line illustration of a tankard or mug positioned in the upper center portion of the page. The mug is drawn with thin, gray pencil lines and has a slightly flared cylindrical body with a large, curved handle on the right side. There are two horizontal bands of parallel lines encircling the body of the mug; one is located around the upper-middle part and the other near the base, with another set of parallel lines forming the rim and the bottom edge. The handle is textured with small, evenly spaced arcs or indents along its outer edge, and it loops in a semicircle to attach near the base. The mug is depicted in a three-dimensional perspective, with its top opening drawn as an ellipse. In the lower right corner, there is a small, similarly drawn inset sketch of the same mug, showing the same perspective and proportions but on a smaller scale. The background remains plain and unshaded throughout the entire composition.
title: Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
